mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an anomaly in language comprehension or/and production."

The leaves are the lexical tokens of the sentence.

Phonology is the study of the sound system of language.

A root node is a node that doesn't have any branches on top of it.

Speech pathology is the term used for the study of all aspects of language disorders.

A clause is a separate part of a complex sentence, as "when he returns" in the last example.

Linguistic semantics is the study of meaning that is used to understand human experience through language.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered a normal process in development."

Phonological development refers to the gradual acquisition of an adult-like system of speech sounds that are used to convey meaning in a language.

Phoneme awareness is the ability for the child to manipulate phonemes, the smallest unit of spoken language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a metaphorical expression used to explain incorrect assumption that people make when they parse words together."
The garden path theory is a metaphorical expression used to explain incorrect assumption that people make when they parse words together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a manifestation of shared knowledge and the ability to access the mental state of the listener."
Successful comprehension is a manifestation of shared knowledge and the ability to access the mental state of the listener.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex array of linguistic cues."
The Speech Recognition Process Language processing is a complex array of linguistic cues.
